question: How do I configure my generators.yml file to publish my C# SDK to NuGet?
ground_truth: To configure your generators.yml file for NuGet publishing, you need to: 1) Set the output location to 'nuget' instead of 'local-file-system', 2) Add a unique package-name for your NuGet package, 3) Configure the client-class-name in PascalCase that customers will use to import your SDK, and 4) Add the api-key field set to ${{NUGET_API_KEY}} for authentication.

metadata.cited_context: In the `group` for your C#/.NET SDK, change the output location from `local-file-system` (the default) to `nuget` to indicate that Fern should publish your package directly to the npm registry... Your package name must be unique in the NuGet repository, otherwise publishing your SDK to NuGet will fail... The `client-class-name` option controls the name of the generated client. This is the name customers use to import your SDK... Add `api-key: ${{NUGET_API_KEY}}` to `generators.yml` to tell Fern to use the `NUGET_API_KEY` environment variable for authentication when publishing to the NuGet registry.
